sections.h2: Crude oil duty was cut twice in sixteen months, to 11% effective

chart.title: Each cut lowered the effective duty on crude palm and soybean oil
chart.sub: Effective duty on crude palm and soybean oil, %, including cesses.
chart.source: Customs notifications No. 43/2024 and No. 31/2025; Department of Consumer Affairs release, 25 September 2026.

sections.means: The basic duty on crude palm and soybean oil went up to 20% in September 2024 and has since been cut to 5%, which with cesses gives an effective 11%.
sections.todo: Watch the October price index as the first real test of whether the September cut reaches shops.

sections.h2: Vegetable oil prices kept rising through both duty cuts

chart.title: The vegetable oils price index is 16% above its May 2025 level
chart.source: MoSPI consumer price index (base 2024), via eSankhyiki API.

sections.means: Prices kept climbing after the May 2025 cut, and the September 2026 reading was collected before the latest duty cut.
sections.todo: Read the October index as the first test of whether the September duty cut reaches consumers.

sections.h2: Palm oil is the largest edible oil import, at 65.34 lakh tonnes in 2025-26

chart.title: Palm oil leads edible oil imports, ahead of soybean and sunflower oil
chart.sub: Edible oil imports, first ten months of the November to October oil year, lakh tonnes.

sections.means: Total edible oil imports reached 136.2 lakh tonnes in the first ten months, 5% more than a year earlier.
sections.todo: Treat rising imports as the baseline, since domestic oilseed output is not yet growing fast enough to replace them.

sections.h2: Oilseed output must grow about 10% a year to meet the 2030-31 target

chart.title: The 2030-31 target needs growth well above the recent pace
chart.source: Government reply to the Lok Sabha, August 2026; National Mission on Edible Oils.

sections.means: The mission asks farmers to grow about 60% more oilseeds by 2030-31 than in 2025-26, while the duty has moved in both directions.
sections.todo: Set a steadier duty path so farmers can plan their kharif sowing.
